Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly analyzed the release years of the two films. It reversed the release years, stating that "Repeated Absences" came out in 1949 and "She Wore a Yellow Ribbon" came out in 1972, despite the WebSurfer providing the correct information (Repeated Absences = 1972, She Wore a Yellow Ribbon = 1949). This misinterpretation of the data led to the incorrect conclusion that "Repeated Absences" came out first.
